nodes.name: Room Temperature Mechanical Stirring
nodes.procedure: Commercial Ni foams employed as conductive support and mechanically stirred with FeCl3 precursor in ethanol at room temperature, during which a new chemical reaction between metallic Ni and FeCl3 occurs, synthesizing amorphous FeOOH and Ni(OH)2 simultaneously to form amorphous mesoporous Ni/Fe (oxy)hydroxide [(Ni,Fe)OOH] film on the Ni foam surface. After growth, the product was cleaned with deionized water and dried in air overnight. The as-prepared multiporous catalysts were then directly utilized.

nodes.description: OER performance in 1 M KOH three-electrode configuration
nodes.source_text: as-prepared multiporous catalysts were then directly utilized as a self-supported anode for water oxidation reaction using a three-electrode configuration in 1 M KOH... It requires an overpotential as low as 174 mV to achieve a current density of 50 mA cm⁻²... our OER catalyst requires overpotentials of only 259 and 289 mV to achieve 500 and 1000 mA cm⁻²... this catalyst withstood accelerated degradation tests, and the overpotential needed to reach a current density of 10 mA cm⁻² varies very little at 154 mV for over 42 h... This catalyst also shows sustainable capability of being operated continuously at 500 and 1000 mA cm⁻² over 44 h with no significant decay

nodes.description: Overall water splitting in 1 M KOH two-electrode configuration
nodes.source_text: we paired our new OER electrocatalyst with a MoNi₄/MoO₂ cuboid array... to make an alkaline electrolyzer in 1 M KOH... this electrolyzer can generate extremely high current densities of 500 and 1000 mA cm⁻² at only 1.586 and 1.657 V... this electrolyzer can sustain its outstanding overall-water-splitting performance with no sign of decay for over 40 h... the Faradaic efficiency... was determined to be nearly 100%
